nodes.name: WAHA Webhook
nodes.notes: WAHA posts inbound message events here. Set this URL in WAHA session config: PUT /api/sessions/fashion-gallery with webhooks[0].url = this URL and events: ['message']. Also set hmac.key for signature verification.

nodes.name: Respond 200 OK
nodes.notes: Always respond 200 immediately so WAHA doesn't retry. Processing continues in parallel.

nodes.name: Normalize Payload
nodes.notes: Extracts phone, chatId, messageText from WAHA payload. Returns skip=true for bot's own outgoing messages.

nodes.name: Skip if fromMe
nodes.notes: If skip=true (message is from the bot itself), stop processing.

parameters.query:
SELECT id AS business_id, business_name, owner_name, whatsapp_number
FROM businesses
WHERE waha_session = '{{ $("Normalize Payload").first().json.sessionName }}' AND status = 'active'
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Get Business by Session
nodes.notes: Resolves business_id from WAHA session name. If no match, business is unknown — add error handling.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (business_id, customer_number, direction, message_text, waha_message_id)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.business_id }}',
  '{{ $("Normalize Payload").first().json.phoneNumber }}',
  'inbound',
  '{{ $("Normalize Payload").first().json.messageText.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $("Normalize Payload").first().json.messageId }}'
)
RETURNING id AS conversation_id;

SELECT direction, message_text, detected_intent, created_at FROM conversations WHERE business_id = '{{ $("Get Business by Session").first().json.business_id }}' AND customer_number = '{{ $("Normalize Payload").first().json.phoneNumber }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;

nodes.name: Build AI Context
nodes.notes: Prepares the conversation context string for the Gemini classifier.

nodes.name: Route by Intent
nodes.notes: Routes to the appropriate workflow sub-path. human_handoff wins over everything else (complaint/explicit request/low confidence). product_inquiry is the fallback for inquiry-type intents.

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE waha_message_id = '{{ $json.messageId }}' LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Check Duplicate
nodes.notes: Idempotency check: see if this exact message ID was already processed.

nodes.name: Is Duplicate?
nodes.notes: If duplicate, stop and respond 200 OK.

messageValues.message:
You are the intent-and-entity extraction layer for the business's WhatsApp
sales assistant.

Given the customer's latest message and up to 3 prior turns of conversation
history for context, return ONLY a JSON object — no prose, no markdown —
matching this schema:

{{
  "intent": "PRODUCT_INQUIRY | PRICE_CHECK | AVAILABILITY_CHECK | OFFER_REQUEST
            | BULK_ORDER | DELIVERY_QUESTION | ORDER_CONFIRMATION | COMPLAINT
            | HUMAN_HANDOFF_REQUEST | GENERAL_QUESTION",
  "confidence": <float 0-1>,
  "entities": {{
    "product_name": <string or null>,
    "product_category": <string or null>,
    "quantity": <integer or null>,
    "variant": <string or null>,
    "budget": <number or null>
  }},
  "language": "<ISO 639-1 code of the language the customer wrote in>"
}}

Rules:
- CRITICAL RULE FOR BULK ORDERS: If the customer asks to buy, purchase, order, or expresses intent to acquire 10 or more units of any item, you MUST classify the intent as BULK_ORDER. This overrides all other intents. Example: "I want to buy 20 hats" MUST be BULK_ORDER.
- Never invent a product_name that wasn't in the message — leave it null if unclear.
- If confidence is below 0.6, still return your best guess; downstream logic
  handles escalation, not you.
- For ORDER_CONFIRMATION: the customer is agreeing to a previously proposed
  order — look for words like "yes", "confirm", "ok", "sure", "place it",
  "go ahead", or equivalent in other languages.
- For COMPLAINT: any expression of dissatisfaction, frustration, or negative
  experience triggers this intent — always escalate regardless of confidence.
- product_category values should match the business's catalog categories:
  tshirt, dress, trousers, jacket, accessories (or null if unknown).
- Return language as "en" for English, "si" for Sinhala, "ta" for Tamil.

CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMATTING:
Because you are running inside a conversational agent parser without tools, you MUST return your final JSON object using the following exact format, otherwise the system will crash!

Thought: I have classified the message.
Final Answer: 
{{
  "intent": "YOUR_INTENT",
  "confidence": 1.0,
  "entities": {{}},
  "language": "en"
}}
